 Madison County
 2027 tax year land use filing deadline
 Madison County Commissioner of the Revenue reminds property owners that the deadline for filing land use revalidations and new applications is November 2, 2026.
 A $50.00 late filing fee will apply to revalidations and new applications received after the November 2 deadline.
 No applications or revalidations will be accepted after December 31, 2026.
 Property owners must submit all required documentation to establish or maintain eligibility for the Land Use Program.
 Commissioner of the Revenue
 P.O. Box 56
 Madison, VA 22727
 Office location: 410 N. Main Street, Madison, VA
 Office hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
